Immunoprecipitations were carried out with antibodies and Protein A/G-agarose beads (Santa Cruz) or Dynabeads Protein G (Invitrogen). For ChIP-seq, DNA libraries were prepared by the HTP Library Preparation Kit for Illimina (KAPA) and sequenced on the NextSeq 500 or NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina).

sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: Cells were treated with 500 µM Auxin (3-indole-acetic acid sodium salt, abcam), 250 nM dBET6 (AOBIOUS), or 20 nM KL-1 (Liang et al. 2018). Heat shock treatment at 42 ˚C for 1 h was carried out as described previously (Mahat et al, 2016)

sample_data_processing: For ChIP-seq, single-end raw reads were trimmed by Trimmomatic 0.33 (Bolger et al., 2014) and aligned to hg19 using Bowtie version 1.1.2, allowing only uniquely mapping reads with up to two mismatches within the 50 bp read. library_construction_protocol: For ChIP-seq, 20-50 million cells were crosslinked with 1% paraformaldehyde (Electron Microscopy Sciences) in PBS for 10 min at r.t. Chromatin was sonicated with the Covaris E220 for 4 min with 10% duty cycle, 140 peak intensity power, 200 cycles per burst. Immunoprecipitations were carried out with antibodies and Protein A/G-agarose beads (Santa Cruz) or Dynabeads Protein G (Invitrogen). For ChIP-seq, DNA libraries were prepared by the HTP Library Preparation Kit for Illimina (KAPA) and sequenced on the NextSeq 500 or NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina).

library_construction_protocol: For ChIP-seq, 20-50 million cells were crosslinked with 1% paraformaldehyde (Electron Microscopy Sciences) in PBS for 10 min at r.t. Chromatin was sonicated with the Covaris E220 for 4 min with 10% duty cycle, 140 peak intensity power, 200 cycles per burst. Immunoprecipitations were carried out with antibodies and Protein A/G-agarose beads (Santa Cruz) or Dynabeads Protein G (Invitrogen). For ChIP-seq, DNA libraries were prepared by the HTP Library Preparation Kit for Illimina (KAPA) and sequenced on the NextSeq 500 or NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina).

sample_data_processing: For ChIP-seq, single-end raw reads were trimmed by Trimmomatic 0.33 (Bolger et al., 2014) and aligned to hg19 using Bowtie version 1.1.2, allowing only uniquely mapping reads with up to two mismatches within the 50 bp read.
